title.ja: 曲面LBMの環状Couette制御：速度・圧力・torque
title.en: Curved LBM annular Couette control: velocity,pressure andtorque

summary.ja: 実円弧交点の2次Lagrange補間とstair-halfwayを、回転内壁の解析Navier–Stokes場に比較します。円柱wakeとは別の追加制御です。
summary.en: Compare true-circle quadratic Lagrange link interpolation andstair halfway against analytic rotating-inner-wall Navier–Stokes flow; anadditional control distinct fromcylinderwake.

assumptions.ja: Rin.2/Rout.4、中心(.5,.5)、内壁接線速度.02、外壁静止、ν.01。N80/160/240、tau.7、T4、整数3840/15360/34560steps、両境界法計6runs。初期は解析場の平衡分布。
assumptions.en: Rin.2/Rout.4,center(.5,.5),inner tangential speed.02,stationary outerwall,nu.01. N80/160/240,tau.7,T4,integer3840/15360/34560steps; both boundaries give sixruns. Initialize equilibrium moments of the analytic field.

algorithm.ja: 円弧交点qから反射特性上の3点2次補間を行います。q<.5はoutgoingの内側2点、q>.5はincomingの内側1点を使用し、q=.5はhalfway。移動壁補正、実force/torqueと非零wall massを台帳化し、floorやmass補正をしません。
algorithm.en: Three-point quadratic interpolation on the reflected characteristic: twointerior outgoing samples forq<.5,oneinterior incoming sample forq>.5,exacthalfway atq=.5. Record movingwall correction,actual force/torque andnonzero wallmass; nofloor ormassrepair.

validation.ja: 群28pytest、環状80判定。独立半径/Cartesian微分7資格、最細速度.03・全点圧力ゲージ.08・torque相対.05、定常性・細分化・stair差・壁込み収支。別の87成分資格に合格済みですが主計算合格とは分けます。 新160/240格子の別29成分資格に合格。
validation.en: Group28pytest;80annular gates. Sevenindependent radial/Cartesian qualifiers,finest velocity.03,fullpointwise pressure-gauge.08,torque relative.05,stationarity/refinement/stair comparison andwallinclusive budgets. Separate87component qualifiers passed; this doesnot imply main success. Separate29newmeshcomponentqualifierspassed.

limits.ja: 固定円弧と低速回転のみ。2次補間は負係数を含み一般の正値性や安定性を保証しません。補間mass非保存は実値を記録。以前の線形版は圧力.617757>.08で不合格として保存し、半径平均への置換なし。移動solidの拓撲変化や円柱の代用ではありません。 2次版旧N80の圧力.352758>.08も不合格として保持し、Ui/tau/Tを変えず両境界を固定細分化します。
limits.en: Fixedcircles andslowrotation only. Negative quadratic coefficients preclude a general positivity/stability guarantee; report actual interpolation massnonconservation. Prior linear attemptfailed pressure.617757>.08 andisretained; no radial-average substitution. No changing-solid topology orsubstitute forcylinderflow. Retain the failedquadraticN80pressure.352758>.08;refinebothboundariesatfixedUi/tau/T.

references.author: Qisu Zou and Xiaoyi He
references.title: On pressure and velocity flow boundary conditions and bounceback for the lattice Boltzmann BGK model
references.review_scope: Selected original preprint pp2-7: standard equilibrium, moment-based flat velocity/density boundaries and corner/finite-Mach limitations. No full-paper audit; special d2q9i accuracy is not credited to this standard BGK.

review.ja: 原著preprintの式と平面流入出境界・角・圧縮性の範囲を選択読解。特殊d2q9iの成功を本BGKへ流用しません。
review.en: Selected primary equations and flat-boundary/corner/compressibility discussion read; special d2q9i successes are not borrowed.

references.author: Pierre Lallemand and Li-Shi Luo
references.title: Lattice Boltzmann method for moving boundaries
references.review_scope: Selected original sec3 printed410-414 via disclosed author-content mirror: Eq12/13/14 quadratic reflected-characteristic interpolation,moving-wall coefficient,Eq15 momentum exchange and compromised mass conservation. Generic Lagrange scalar oracle independently qualifies weights andsigns. No localPDF/rendered-symbol audit;2001BFLfulloriginal remains unread.

review.ja: 原著選択部分Eq12–15の2次補間・壁補正・運動量交換・mass非保存を読解。汎用Lagrange式の独立scalarで係数を資格。2001原著全文や局所PDFの画像確認は未実施です。
review.en: Read selected original Eq12–15 on quadratic links,wall correction,momentum exchange andmassnonconservation; qualify by a generic-Lagrange scalar oracle. No2001fulltext orlocalPDFsymbol audit.
